prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity, flat front-facing desktop browser application screen for PDV Lojas Manu, landscape 1536x1024. This is a working point-of-sale UI concept for computer keyboard and mouse, NOT a marketing page, not a photograph or device mockup. The input screenshot is REFERENCE ONLY for established identity: inherit its sober blue #0369a1 primary, #f8fafc page ground, white surfaces, #0f172a readable text, Segoe UI/Inter-like sans-serif, MUI-style controls and gently rounded corners. Recompose the structure as explicitly described below; do not copy the old large nested cards, wasted space, cropped totals, scrollbars, stale client, developer buttons or floating browser pet. Compact calm precision, professional operational polish. Prefer light separators and minimal shadows, clear labels, enough spacing to read quickly. One main focus is the sale total/action, while product rows remain easy to scan. No charts, KPI cards, photos, invented stock/credit indicators, neon, gradients, enormous radii, currency mistakes, watermarks. Single complete screen fits within the image, all primary controls and total visible.
Shared shell: a modest white left navigation 190px wide, brand Lojas Manu and menu items Dashboard, PDV (blue selected), Pedidos, Clientes, Produtos, Relatórios, Configurações; user section Operador at bottom. Slim main header: PDV, Rascunho local, Atalhos. Small discreet note Dados fictícios · Proposta visual. No assigned order number before saving.
Use identical synthetic content across proposals: Cliente de demonstração, phone (00) 00000-0000, selected address Rua Exemplo, 123 · Centro / Fortaleza – CE · CEP 00000-000; label Principal with Trocar endereço action. Tipo de atendimento Venda; Forma de pagamento Dinheiro; optional Observações. Cart with four distinct readable rows and columns Produto, Qtd, Valor unit., Total, actions. Row 1 Produto A — modelo padrão, DEMO-01, qty 2, R$ 89,90, R$ 179,80. Row 2 Produto B — variação azul, DEMO-02, qty 1, R$ 59,90, R$ 59,90. Row 3 Produto C — kit de demonstração, DEMO-03, qty 3, R$ 19,90, R$ 59,70. Row 4 Produto D — modelo compacto, DEMO-04, qty 1, R$ 39,90, R$ 39,90. 4 itens · 7 unidades. Subtotal R$ 339,30; Desconto geral R$ 20,00; TOTAL R$ 319,30. Primary button Salvar pedido; secondary Imprimir rascunho; quiet Cancelar. Saving creates Pendente, not Finalizado; no fabricated status transition. Portuguese labels must be accurate and legible. Display no keyboard shortcut next to new action unless specified: F2 product search, F3 client search are existing. Flat coherent iconography with accessible-sized actions.
COMPOSITION C: DUAS ÁREAS. Main topology: below slim header, left workspace about 68 percent wide for products/cart, right workspace about 32 percent wide for customer/payment/context. Keep BOTH regions displayed simultaneously, not a step wizard and not a context strip only. Left has long Buscar produto (F2) and compact Qtd/Adicionar row; below a flat table Itens do pedido with the four readable 64px rows, product names broad, quantity editable, prices and totals aligned right, edit and menu. Compact current item optional settings Preço, Desconto, Cor are secondary, not a huge card. Right has a white quiet panel Dados da venda with Cliente (F3) selected Cliente de demonstração plus Novo secondary, full selected address with Principal and Trocar endereço, then labelled Tipo de atendimento Venda and Forma de pagamento Dinheiro selectors always visible, optional Observações and compact Desconto geral R$ 20,00. Only these details may scroll independently. At bottom, a FIXED horizontal checkout band across main workspace showing 4 itens · 7 unidades left, Subtotal R$ 339,30 and Desconto R$ 20,00 middle, prominently TOTAL R$ 319,30 beside blue Salvar pedido right, print/cancel quiet secondary. No primary action below screen. Primary total/action focal moment, blue restrained. Fit 1366x768-like operational density with full screen uncropped.
